details.question: 广东、浙江、四川三省的销售额对比

details.question: 手机数码和家用电器两个品类的销售情况对比
details.sql:
SELECT dim_product.category, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS total_sales, SUM(fact_order.order_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM fact_order
JOIN dim_product ON fact_order.product_id = dim_product.product_id
WHERE dim_product.category IN ('手机数码', '家用电器')
GROUP BY dim_product.category
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

details.question: 黄金会员和铂金会员的消费能力对比
details.sql: SELECT dim_customer.member_level, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS total_sales, AVG(fact_order.order_amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM fact_order JOIN dim_customer ON fact_order.customer_id = dim_customer.customer_id WHERE dim_customer.member_level IN ('黄金', '铂金') GROUP BY dim_customer.member_level ORDER BY total_sales DESC
